product.careBody: Favour gentle care: low-temperature washing or the cleaning method suited to the material, then air dry. Store your pieces away from direct light to preserve their colour.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: Allow 2 to 4 business days in France, 4 to 7 business days for the UK.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in its original packaging. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

items.question: How do I know my size?

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: We currently ship to France and the UK. More countries will follow.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: A confirmation email is sent after your order, including your order number.

about.title: About DivinExpress
about.paragraph1: DivinExpress was built on a simple conviction: clothing should hold its shape, literally and figuratively. Every collection starts from a silhouette, not a trend.
about.paragraph2: We work with a deliberately small number of materials and suppliers, to keep full control over the cut, construction, and finish of every piece.
about.paragraph3: Men, women, kids, accessories: one standard runs through every category — every piece is built to last, and built to command attention.

sections.heading: Personal data and cookies
body: DivinExpress SAS attaches great importance to the confidentiality and security of your personal information. The conditions for collecting and processing data collected on the Site are detailed in our Privacy Policy, available at the bottom of the page.
The Site only uses technical cookies strictly necessary for the operation of the online store (remembering navigation language, currency, and the content of your shopping basket).

sections.heading: Applicable law and jurisdiction
body: These legal notices are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute regarding their interpretation or execution, and in the absence of an amicable resolution or recourse to an approved mediator, the competent French courts under the jurisdiction of the registered office of DivinExpress SAS shall have sole authority to resolve the dispute.

sections.heading: Purpose and scope
body: These Terms of Sale define the contractual rights and obligations within the framework of sales of clothing and accessories concluded remotely via the DivinExpress website ("the Site") between DivinExpress SAS ("the Seller") and any individual acting as a consumer ("the Customer").

Any order confirmed on the Site implies full, prior, and unreserved acceptance by the Customer of these Terms of Sale. The Seller reserves the right to modify these Terms of Sale at any time. The applicable Terms are those in force and accepted by the Customer at the time of final validation of the order.

sections.heading: Product presentation
body: The items offered for sale are those appearing on the Site on the day of consultation, within the limit of available stocks at our workshops. Each product is accompanied by a descriptive sheet detailing its main characteristics (composition, sizes, colors, and prices).

Photographs and illustrations are intended to be as faithful as possible to the real items but cannot guarantee perfect similarity, particularly regarding how colors and textures are rendered on screen.

sections.heading: Prices of articles
body: Prices of our items are indicated on the Site in euros (€) or pounds sterling (£) depending on the selected currency. They are expressed including all taxes (TTC) at the VAT rate applicable in France on the day of the order, excluding shipping and delivery costs, which are billed in addition.

Applicable shipping costs are calculated and clearly displayed before the final confirmation of the order by the Customer. The Seller reserves the right to modify its prices at any time; items are billed based on the rates shown when the order is registered.

sections.heading: Ordering process
body: To validate an order, the Customer must follow these steps: select items and add them to the cart, review the cart summary, enter contact details and complete delivery address, select a secure payment method, accept the Terms of Sale, and confirm the transaction.

An email acknowledging receipt of the order and confirming its registration is sent automatically to the Customer. The Seller reserves the right to cancel or refuse any order from a Customer with whom there is a dispute relating to the payment of a previous order.

sections.heading: Payment terms
body: Payment of purchases is made in full on the day of ordering. Online payments are fully secure and are processed through our approved partners (Stripe, PayPal, GeniusPay) by credit card or digital wallet.

The Seller never has access to your banking information, and no payment data is stored on our servers. The order will only be shipped once authorization of payment has been confirmed by the official payment centers.

sections.heading: Shipping and delivery
body: Deliveries are made to the address indicated by the Customer when placing the order. The Seller currently ships to metropolitan France and the United Kingdom. Shipments are processed within 24 to 48 business hours after receipt of payment.

Average transit times are 2 to 4 business days for France and 4 to 7 business days for the United Kingdom. Delivery is free for any order of an amount equal to or greater than €150 (or equivalent in currency).

sections.heading: Legal right of withdrawal
body: In accordance with Article L.221-18 of the French Consumer Code, the Customer has a legal period of 14 clear days from the physical receipt of their items to exercise their right of withdrawal without having to justify reasons or pay penalties.

To exercise this right, the Customer must inform customer service of their decision in writing. The direct costs of returning the goods remain the sole responsibility of the Customer, unless our commercial policy states otherwise.

sections.heading: Returns and refunds policy
body: For commercial flexibility, DivinExpress extends the return period to 30 days from receipt of the items. Products must be returned in their original condition, unworn, unwashed, with their original labels, and in their complete original packaging.

After receipt and validation by our workshops of the conformity of the returned items, the refund will be processed within a maximum period of 14 days using the same payment method used for the initial purchase.

sections.heading: Legal warranties
body: The Seller guarantees the conformity of the products sold (Articles L.217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) and hidden defects of the item sold (Articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code).

When acting under the legal warranty of conformity, the Customer has a period of 2 years from delivery of the product to act and is exempted from providing proof of the existence of the lack of conformity during this period.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: The Seller cannot be held liable for damages resulting from improper use of the clothing purchased, natural wear and tear of materials, or in the event of force majeure as defined by the French courts (strikes, natural disasters, epidemics).

sections.heading: Personal data
body: Personal information collected from the Customer is essential for processing orders and establishing invoices. This data is processed confidentially in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Applicable law and dispute resolution
body: These Terms of Sale are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the Customer is invited to contact customer service first to find an amicable solution.

In the absence of an amicable agreement, the Customer has the option to submit the dispute to an approved consumer mediator. If no amicable solution is found, French courts under the jurisdiction of DivinExpress SAS's registered office shall have sole authority.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: DivinExpress SAS, registered with the Paris Trade and Companies Register, is the data controller of personal data collected from users on the DivinExpress website.

For any questions regarding your personal data or to exercise your rights, you can write to us at the following address: [POSTAL ADDRESS OF CONTROLLER TO BE COMPLETED], or by email at contact@divinexpress.fr.

sections.heading: Personal data collected
body: We collect information that you voluntarily provide when placing an order and interacting with our customer service: title, first name, last name, email address, delivery and billing address, phone number.

Data relating to your browsing preferences (choice of language, currency, cart contents, and favorites list) are stored locally in your browser (via localStorage/sessionStorage) and are never collected or stored on our servers.

sections.heading: Purposes of data processing
body: Your personal data is processed for specific purposes: the management, tracking, and delivery of your orders, the preparation of invoices and maintenance of our accounts, customer relationship management (returns, complaints, and assistance), and detecting fraud during checkout.

sections.heading: Legal bases for processing
body: The collection of your data is based on the following legal bases: the execution of obligations arising from the sales contract (processing and delivery of your order), compliance with our legal obligations (accounting and tax archiving), and the legitimate interest of DivinExpress (responding to your requests sent via the contact form).

sections.heading: Data sharing and recipients
body: Your personal information is strictly confidential and is only transmitted to DivinExpress SAS's trusted technical service providers in order to ensure the service: our shipping and delivery subcontractors (carriers), and our secure payment solution providers (Stripe, PayPal, GeniusPay).
DivinExpress commits to never selling, renting, or transferring your personal data to third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Data retention period
body: Personal data essential for processing your orders is kept in our active database for the duration of the commercial relationship. It is then archived as part of our legal and accounting obligations for a period of 10 years.
Data related to contact forms is kept for a maximum of 3 years from the date of the last exchange.

sections.heading: Security and data protection
body: DivinExpress implements rigorous physical, technical, and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or accidental destruction.

sections.heading: Your rights and data access
body: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and national regulations, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, restrict, and object to the processing of your data.

You can exercise these rights at any time by sending your request by email to contact@divinexpress.fr or by post. For security reasons, we may ask you for proof of identity if there is any reasonable doubt.

sections.heading: Use of Cookies
body: The Site exclusively uses local functional cookies necessary to remember your browsing choices (language, currency, cart, favorites). No third-party advertising trackers or targeting cookies are used on the Site.

sections.heading: Complaint with the supervisory authority
body: If you believe, after contacting us, that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you have the right to file an official complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL) on its website: www.cnil.fr.
